notes.title: 🚨 ULTRAKILL CROSSOVER update! 🚨
notes.notes:
Get ready for the ultimate challenge in Mullet MadJack! The new update introduces the Boss Rush Mode and an explosive surprise: an unprecedented crossover with ULTRAKILL, the frenetic retro FPS sensation. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215710/48b91a4a073a4cdd546f55f2db0371ed66326cc9.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215710/86b2db1b424659d69a86479ccb239fc0d0739794.png
⚔️ What is Boss Rush Mode? ⚔️ 

Face a relentless sequence of bosses in a race against time. The faster you defeat them, the higher you'll climb on the global leaderboards. Show off your skills and claim your spot at the top! 

💀 ULTRAKILLER Spoiler:The final showdown in Boss Rush Mode features a special boss straight from ULTRAKILL! Yes, one of the most iconic villains from its ultraviolent universe is here, specially designed for this mode, ready to push your skills to the limit. Can you conquer this epic battle? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215710/86b2db1b424659d69a86479ccb239fc0d0739794.png
🎉 Launch Discount! 🎉 

Celebrate the occasion with 25% off Mullet MadJack during the update launch. Don’t miss your chance to tackle the challenge at a special price! 

🗓️ Release Date: December 19, 2024

(Katana players can now make a more throw based build)

notes.title: Patch Update and new ENDLESS modes unlocked
notes.notes:
What's New in Endless Mode:  We call it the ENDLESS JOURNEY, and this will be the first addition of many modes in the future. 

New Unlockable Modes:  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215710/b1606bf0df06f81d11a2510fa12cd334ed51eab2.jpg

Weapon Roulette: Each weapon is generated randomly, and you never know what you're going to get. Just deal with it, no one said surviving would be easy! 

Happy Foot: No weapons, just creativity and kicks to ascend the floors. Kick your way through and knock everything down! 

YOU UNLOCK THOSE MODES "BEATING" THE ENDLESS MODE ON FLOOR 30.

New Rewards:  

Two new super stylish sneakers for you to collect and impress your fans every time you complete a round in endless mode. If you pick the 3 sneakers on endless mode, you will get a secret sneaker to transcend consumism!

notes.title: WEEK 1 PATCH 1.01
notes.notes:
This patch is a small one focused on the most immediate matters about the launch week that we detected.

PATCH NOTES:

- V-SYNC added to options. Marked off by default. It may fix some issues with frame drops.

- STEAM DECK saves: Fixed bugs between save interactions carried out from pc to steamdeck and vice versa messing up with the game.

- DOOR LOCKER UPGRADE: Bug that inactivates it in some instances.

- YELLOW SHOES achievement not triggering even if you pick the shoes. (ALL SHOES ACHIEVEMENTS WILL BE DOUBLE CHECKED WHEN YOU ENTER CONTROLS IN OPTIONS.)

- MORE LENIENT PITS: Now you don't die on a pit, but teleport to the beginning of the pit section as a punishment.

- Shop screen mouselock fixed.

- FINISH ITEMS UNUSABLE fixed.

- RIFLE not appearing on endless and permadeath was fixed. (You can get the rifle as a prize in the unboxing.)

- WEAPONS UPGRADE SYSTEM: now better communicated to the player.

- HANDHELD devices that are not steamdeck - legion go and similar - now we have resolutions on portrait mode.

- The game now autosaves only between stages to increase security.

- DECALS of WEAPONS optimized.

- Some scenario collisions fixed.

- POLISH CHARACTERS ADDED

- Lots of language fixes.

- Lots of small fixes.

KNOWN ISSUES FOR NEXT PATCHES:


- Performance drops after play the game for some time being addressed with caution and care.

- DECAL optimization for other weapons and decal bugs on the last section.

- MENU OPTIONS for Jack and streamer talking, skipping tutorials and hints, timescale slider?

- Revised Japanese and Chinese.

- Characters for Ukrainian.

- Small visual and usability bugs.
